high_level_description: The image shows a wooden chaise lounge with an ornate design. The frame of the chaise is made of polished wood with intricate carvings on the arms and legs, giving it a classic and elegant appearance. The upholstery features a patterned fabric with a black and white geometric design, adding a touch of sophistication to the piece. On the right side of the chaise, there is a blue plush toy resembling Doraemon, a popular Japanese cartoon character. The toy is sitting upright on the cushion, adding a playful and casual element to the otherwise formal setting.
